[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685807/6e52907c75ba0669b6db18f856ea0c7623bcf790.png[/img]

Hello, I'm Ferry and also Ollie, involved in the creation of Dependun. We continually refer to discussions on Steam, reviews, and other websites to enhance our development process.

We've made significant efforts in improving the save feature with this update, given the frequent bugs encountered. We're committed to addressing this issue continually.
